summary: Fixed get_timezone_location in babel/dates.py so that when a locale (and its parent chain) has no name for the unknown-region territory 'ZZ', it falls back to the English 'ZZ' name instead of raising KeyError; this clears all 138 test_no_inherit_metazone_marker_never_in_output cases in my shard.
